doc: stages/writers.copc.rst, Options: extra_dims 'Extra dimensions to be written as part of each point beyond those specified by the LAS point format.  The format of the option is ``<dimension_name>=<type> [, ...]``.  Any valid PDAL :ref:`type <types>` can be specified.'  The option takes a comma-separated list, so two names in one string both have to be honoured.  The extra-dimension NAMES are asserted through the `las` check's `header` block, which is where the driver implements `extra_dimension_names`; the `copc` check kind does not read that key, so stating it there would never have run.
